full_prompt_en: A square, luminous anime painting shows two fighters standing back to back among violet flowers and drifting points of light. The background is an abstract twilight glow: warm gold and cream gather behind the figures at the upper right, while deep purple and charcoal shade the upper left. Soft circles and tiny sparks float through the air, giving the space a dreamlike depth without a defined horizon. The man stands left of center, taller and broader, facing toward the left. Short spiky dark hair and a stern profile rise above a high dark collar and close-fitting charcoal clothing. A narrow sword hilt with a warm metallic cap appears beside his lower left arm, partly hidden by the foreground flowers. The woman stands on the right, turned away from him and looking toward the right. Her blond hair is arranged in a short rounded bun with loose fringe strands, and her serious face is lit along the cheek and jaw. Purple armor or a structured dress covers the shoulders and torso, with dark crossing lines and a fitted waist leading to a deep violet lower garment. Their shoulders nearly touch, creating one paired silhouette even as their gazes separate. Pale lilac blossoms and dark green stems crowd the bottom edge; some flowers are softly out of focus close to the viewer, while others near the figures are more distinct. Warm backlight outlines the blond hair and right shoulder, and smaller lavender highlights catch the flowers. The man's face remains cooler and darker, with selective light along the nose and hair tips. Smooth gradients model the figures, while fine painted grain and scattered bokeh soften the scene around them. No readable text appears. The overall composition is heroic and wistful, using opposed profiles, warm-cool lighting, and a low sea of violet blooms to bind stillness with emotional tension.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、发光的日系动画绘画描绘两名战士背靠背站在紫色花丛与漂浮光点之间。背景是一片抽象暮光：暖金与乳白聚在人物身后右上方，深紫与炭色罩住左上。柔软光圆和细小火星漂在空气里，为没有明确地平线的空间添入梦境般纵深。男子站在中央偏左，更高也更宽，朝左方。深色短刺发和严肃侧脸从高深色领口与贴身炭色服装上方升起。一截带暖色金属帽的窄剑柄出现在他的左下手臂旁，部分被前景花朵遮住。女子站在右侧，背离他并望向右方。金发盘成短而圆的发髻，留有散开的刘海；严肃面孔沿脸颊与下颌受光。紫色甲衣或结构鲜明的裙装覆盖肩与躯干，深色交叉线条和收紧腰部通向深紫下装。两人肩膀几乎相触，虽目光分开，仍形成一组相连剪影。浅丁香色花朵和深绿茎叶挤满底边；贴近观者的花有些柔化失焦，靠近人物的则较清楚。暖背光勾亮金发和右肩，较小的淡紫亮点落在花上。男子的脸较冷较暗，只在鼻梁和发尖有选择性的亮光。平滑渐层塑造人物，细绘画颗粒和散落光斑则柔化四周。没有可读文字。整体构图英勇而惆怅，以相反侧脸、冷暖光与低处成片紫花，把静止与情绪张力连在一起。
style_prompt_en: The luminous anime painting models clear focal forms with smooth gradients while surrounding them with soft bokeh and delicate painted grain. Warm gold and cream glow against deep violet and charcoal, with lilac highlights repeated in small accents below. Two or more upright silhouettes can form a compact central anchor, their contours sharpened by rim light while the outer field dissolves into atmospheric sparkle. Cool shadow on one side and warm backlight on the other make the volume legible without harsh graphic separation. Near foreground details blur into broad colored patches; middle details remain sharper, creating shallow depth. Fine scattered points punctuate the dark areas and connect the composition vertically. The overall effect is romantic and dramatic, with restrained posture carrying weight inside an expansive light-filled atmosphere.
style_prompt_zh: 这种发光的日系动画绘画以平滑渐层塑造清楚焦点形体，四周包围柔软散景与细绘画颗粒。暖金和乳白辉光对照深紫与炭色，小面积丁香色亮点在下方重复。两个或更多直立剪影可组成紧凑中央锚点，轮廓由边缘光挑亮，外围色域则消融为带光点的空气。冷色一侧阴影与另一侧暖背光让体积清楚，不依赖坚硬图形分割。近前景细节模糊成宽阔色斑，中部细节较锐利，建立浅层纵深。稀疏细光点穿插暗处，纵向连接构图。整体效果浪漫而戏剧化，克制姿态在宽阔光感空气中具有重量。
theme_en: Two anime fighters stand back to back among glowing violet flowers
theme_zh: 两名动画战士背靠背站在发光的紫色花丛中
name: FateZero
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
